newsitem.title: UK: Another 650,000 bls Forties deferred to Aug-trade.
newsitem.headline: Another 650,000 bls Forties deferred to Aug-trade.

text.p: Loading of 650,000 barrels of North Sea Forties crude originally scheduled in July and held as equity by Exxon has been deferred to August due to production problems at the Nelson field, a trader said.

Exxon had been informed earlier this week that 250,000 of their barrels would have to be delayed until August and later were told that an additional 400,000 barrels would also have to be deferred, the trader said.
